parameters.text: =Read the attached receipt image. Business purpose given by the employee: {{ $json.business_purpose }}

messageValues.message: You read scanned expense receipts. Extract the merchant name, receipt date, currency, total amount and every line item with quantity and line total. Classify each line item into exactly one category: meals (food and non-alcoholic drinks), alcohol (beer, wine, spirits, cocktails, bar drinks), travel (taxi, cab, ride-hailing, fuel, parking, tolls, train, flight, bus), accommodation (hotel, lodging), office_supplies (stationery, printer ink, small office equipment), entertainment (movies, events, recreation), other (anything else, including taxes or tips shown as separate lines). Copy amounts exactly as printed; never guess missing values - leave text empty or use 0. Set is_readable to false if the image is not a legible receipt.
